results.note: Page (regional tourism board) lists 'Plein tarif : 12 €' (reduced 9 €; free under 26). Aquarium-only ticket; the official palais-portedoree.fr page was not reachable to confirm.
Visit Paris Region page's Prices section lists the market as 'Free'. Open-air market, no admission charge.

The official Centre Pompidou page states no price. It says the works were moved back to the museum during renovation. A Time Out listing says free entry, but it conflicts with the closure notice, so I did not use it.

The official site lists 'Price: 22€' for Sainte-Chapelle admission, with free entry for EU residents under 26. The page gives no seasonal breakdown. Third-party sources suggested lower winter prices (about 15 €), but I could not confirm that on an official page.
